title: The third volume of the Heavenly Book
summary: The Black Water Serpent's poison is too strong, and Lin Jingyu is hurt as the disciples fall back, unable to get past it to the vault door. Then the Yellow Bird, the legendary Nine Heavens Spirit Bird and the vault's guardian, appears and the two ancient beasts fight. Inside the vault Gui Li wakes beside Lu Xueqi; their wounds have healed, and he tells her she owes him nothing since she came in before the stone door shut. Lu Xueqi refuses to let him take the treasure unless he kills her first. Gui Li finds the third volume of the Heavenly Book, which he can read only because he has studied the first two. Outside, Qing Long and Zhu Que hold their formation and wait for their moment. The episode ends on Xiao Hui doing something unexpected.
